24/7 ICU Air Ambulance & Medical Evacuation from the UAE

Transparent Pricing

Air Ambulance & Airline Stretcher Costs from the UAE

The cost of medical repatriation from the UAE depends on the chosen transport configuration, the destination, and the level of ICU care required. We provide tailored medical transit options ranging from Dedicated ICU Air Ambulances for critical patients to highly cost-effective Commercial Airline Stretcher Services and Flight Medical Escorts for stable individuals. Every mission is custom-planned to align perfectly with the patient's precise medical needs.

We deliver fully transparent, all-inclusive pricing for all international medical evacuations from the UAE, with absolutely no hidden fees. Our pricing covers end-to-end medical logistics — including bedside-to-bedside ground ambulance transfers, specialized flight crews, medical clearance documentation, and airline coordination. Whether utilizing a private air ambulance or a commercial airline stretcher setup, we guarantee the highest global safety standards at competitive rates.

We provide medical transfers from major UAE cities, including Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and Sharjah, to destinations across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, North America, and worldwide, ensuring seamless bedside-to-bedside patient transportation with ICU air ambulance, commercial stretcher, medical escort, and coordinated ground ambulance services.

Contact our Global Command Center 24/7 for a customized quote. Our dispatch team responds within 30 minutes.

Global Air Ambulance Service – Emergency Medical Evacuation 24X7

Seamless air ambulance and medical evacuation services, delivering end-to-end patient transfer across more than 100 countries - managed with precision from the first call to final admission.

06

Air Ambulance

ICU-equipped aircraft with FAA-approved life support and a dedicated medical crew - safe, end-to-end transfer of critical patients across international borders, bed to bed.

Get Quote

Airline Stretcher Services

A cost-effective stretcher arrangement on commercial flights, equipped with onboard oxygen, continuous monitoring, and trained medical supervision throughout the journey.

Get Quote

Flight Medical Escort Services

A qualified doctor or paramedic accompanies the patient on a scheduled flight, ensuring professional care, medication, and monitoring from departure to arrival.

Get Quote

ECMO Transfer Services

Specialized transport for the most critical cardiac and respiratory cases, with an ECMO-trained team delivering uninterrupted life support at altitude.

Get Quote

Organ Transplant Assistance

Time-critical transport of organs and surgical teams with green-corridor priority and precise, zero-delay coordination across every mission.

Get Quote

Medical Tourism

Seamless coordination for patients travelling to India or other countries for specialized treatment - including hospital liaison, scheduling, visa assistance, and complete medical travel support.

Get Quote

Why Families in the UAE Rely on Air Medical 24X7

01

Every Mission Carries a Life That Matters

Each transfer is executed with advanced clinical training, precise coordination, and complete operational accountability. Trusted by over 17,000 families worldwide — including thousands of UAE-based expat families — we provide dependable air ambulance care of the highest standard.

02

UAE Office — Rapid Local Response

Our Dubai operations center is located near Dubai International Airport Terminal 1. Ground ambulance dispatch, airport coordination, and flight logistics are managed locally — ensuring the fastest possible response across all 7 emirates.

03

Transparent, All-Inclusive Pricing

Clarity is essential in critical situations. We provide clear, all-inclusive cost estimates with no hidden charges — determined by destination, aircraft type, and medical requirements. Our UAE team provides a full quote within 30 minutes of your call.

04

Operations Built on Global Standards

Every aircraft is fitted with FAA-approved medical equipment, and our operations adhere to internationally recognized benchmarks — including ISO 9001:2015 certification — ensuring excellence in aircraft readiness, clinical expertise, and patient care across all UAE departures.

Frequently Asked Questions

Get clear answers about air ambulance costs, response times, and insurance coordination for UAE departures.

Talk to an Expert arrow_forward
The cost of an air ambulance from UAE to India depends on the origin emirate, destination city in India, aircraft type, and level of medical care required onboard. For stable patients, a commercial airline stretcher or flight medical escort is a more affordable option. Contact our UAE team for a precise quote within 30 minutes.
We cover all 7 emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain. Ground ambulance is coordinated from the patient's location in any emirate to the nearest departure airport, with the full transfer managed by our UAE operations team.
For dedicated ICU air ambulance, dispatch is typically within 4–6 hours of confirmation. For commercial airline stretcher and flight medical escort, we work with available flight schedules — usually same day or next day. Our UAE team responds to all enquiries within 30 minutes.
Many UAE health insurance policies and international travel insurance plans include medical evacuation coverage. We assist with insurance documentation and pre-authorization. Contact our team with your policy details and we will confirm coverage and coordinate directly with your insurer.
This depends entirely on the patient's medical condition. For critical, unstable patients on ventilator or ECMO support — a dedicated ICU air ambulance is mandatory. For stable patients who can sit or lie on a stretcher — a commercial flight with medical escort is safe and significantly more affordable. Our medical team assesses the patient's condition and recommends the right option.
Our UAE operations team coordinates a licensed ground ambulance from the patient's location — hospital, home, or clinic — to the departure airport in the relevant emirate. The medical team travels with the patient throughout, ensuring continuous care from bedside to aircraft.
